description:
For people in Japan who want to sell a used motorcycle, moped or scooter.

What this app does
- Model identification: from a loose description such as "the 150cc Honda PCX" or "a 50cc scooter I used to ride", it matches the vehicle against our dataset of 842 models. Models not in the dataset are directed to a phone consultation.
- Estimated buyback price by condition: an estimate in Japanese yen across five condition grades - like-new, running/very good, running/typical for its age, running with damage or faults, and non-running or accident-damaged.
- Request a free on-site appraisal: it submits the customer's name, phone number, area and model, then returns a reference number. The appointment is NOT fixed at that moment; our staff call back to agree the date. Up to three preferred times can be included (all optional).

Service area
Seven prefectures: Kanagawa, Tokyo, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Gunma and Yamanashi. The area widens as we add partner dealers. Travel, appraisal and cancellation are all free of charge.

Who carries out the appraisal
Every request is received by UsedBikeCenter ZAMA and we handle all first contact. Inside Kanagawa we visit and buy directly. In the other six prefectures we introduce a partner secondhand-goods dealer, and that partner carries out the on-site appraisal and the purchase; we act as the introducer and receive a referral fee. In those cases the request details - name, phone number, area, model, condition, preferred times and notes - are shared with that partner and used only to arrange and carry out the appraisal. This is stated in our privacy policy.

Before anything is sent
The tool first returns a preview of the request together with the sharing notice above. It transmits only after the customer has reviewed it and given explicit consent. Until then the tool returns the preview only.

No payments inside ChatGPT
This app only looks up price estimates and submits a request for a free appraisal. There is no payment, checkout, order or purchase of goods in ChatGPT. All figures are non-binding estimates; the final price is agreed after the vehicle is inspected in person. This is C2B - the shop buys from the customer and does not sell vehicles.

UsedBikeCenter ZAMA, Zama City, Kanagawa, Japan
Licensed secondhand goods dealer: Kanagawa Prefectural Public Safety Commission No. 452790009540
Phone: +81 50-3637-3699 (open daily, 9:00-21:00 JST)
